summary: The prior kind/order blockers are corrected and all supplied tests pass, but optimizer state schema and the complete ownership summary are not fail-closed before raw load or update.

checks.expanded_suite_result: 11 tests passed; 13 failing subcases across the state-schema and complete-summary tests reproduced the blockers

blockers.finding: Checkpoint state validation checks only that top-level parameter IDs are integers in the allowed set. Missing parameter state, missing or extra nested fields, wrong tensor shape/dtype/contiguity, invalid step type, swapped state and an empty state all reached raw_load_state_dict and were accepted, mutating the live optimizer.
blockers.required_correction: Define and validate the exact per-kind optimizer-state schema and exact expected parameter-state key set before raw_load_state_dict. Reject every mismatch without invoking the raw loader or changing parameters, optimizer state, counters or collectives. If a pristine zero-step state is supported, encode it as an explicit distinct schema rather than accepting arbitrary omissions.

blockers.finding: The live-plan gate authenticates only summary.replicated_rmsprop_groups. Drift in elements_by_owner, estimated_ms_by_owner, shard_elements or total_padded_bytes is accepted and a real update and collective proceed.
blockers.required_correction: Freeze and validate the complete ownership summary before state_dict, load_state_dict and every update/collective, while preserving intentional runtime optimizer hyperparameter schedules.
